articles.title: Angels go out swinging (and missing) in 100th loss of the season
articles.description: They strike out 12 times in loss to the Mariners securing the first 100-loss season in franchise history, which is a 10-game slide from 2025 when the Angels had a 72-90 record.

articles.title: Angels’ Ben Joyce still working back into form after shoulder surgery
articles.description: Joyce, who missed a season and a half recovering from shoulder surgery, has been back since early August, but he still is trying to get comfortable with his slider and improve his control.

articles.title: Angels’ Zach Neto reflects on a season in which he wasn’t himself early
articles.description: Neto, 26, is finishing off his third straight 20/20 season. On the down side, he struck out more than 200 times and played sloppy defense at times. He’s gotten better late in the season.

articles.title: Angels slug their way to victory in Seattle

articles.title: Angels rally to get a victory for Grayson Rodriguez in his final start
articles.description: Rodriguez gives up four runs in five innings, and the Angels take the lead on a Christian Moore two-run double just in time for him to get credit for the win in a 6-4 victory over the Mariners.
